app.name: Meridian Workforce
app.tagline: Hire, run projects and score KPIs in one place.
app.blurb: Designation ladders, hiring rounds, project timelines with check-ins, and KPIs built from real delivery data.
shell.signOutBody: You will be returned to the sign-in page. Unsaved form changes will be lost.
shell.searchSoon: Search arrives with the People and Tasks modules.
shell.notificationsSoon: Notifications arrive with the Tasks module.
shell.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.
guide.foot: Press Esc or click outside to close.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your work email.
login.demoHint: Development build only. Click to sign in.
login.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
login.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
twofa.title: Two-factor check
twofa.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twofa.recoveryBody: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your work email. If it belongs to an account, we'll send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalid: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.
dashboard.greetingBody: Your dashboard fills up as each module goes live: tasks and check-ins, approvals, KPI and meetings.
profile.pictureHint: Only you see this picture. Everyone else sees the first letter of your display name.
profile.pictureTooBig: Pictures can be at most 3 MB.
profile.pictureType: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP picture.
profile.stillChecking: The picture is still being checked. Try again in a minute.
profile.pictureRejected: The picture didn't pass the safety check. Try another one.
profile.displayNameHint: Shown across the system. Others see the first letter of your display name as your avatar.
profile.moreSoon: Personal information, designation and reporting line arrive with the People module.
profile.noEmployee: This account isn't linked to an employee record.
profile.setupRequiredBody: Your organisation requires two-factor authentication. Add an authenticator app to continue.
pw.title: Change password
pw.done: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
tfa.title: Two-factor authentication
tfa.addIntro: Name the device, then scan the QR code with your authenticator app or enter the key by hand.
tfa.removeBody: Codes from this device will stop working.
tfa.lastRequired: Your organisation requires two-factor authentication, so you can't remove your last device. Add another one first.
tfa.regenerateBody: Your current recovery codes will stop working.
tfa.codesBody: Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe.
tfa.confirmBody: For your security, enter your password to manage two-factor authentication.
settings.stale: Someone else changed the settings. The latest values are now shown; make your change again.
settings.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.
settings.companyNameHint: Shown in the app and on public forms
settings.timezoneHint: Used for due dates and reminders
settings.workingDaysHint: Used for check-in intervals and due dates
settings.twoFaHint: Require an authenticator code at sign-in.
settings.twoFaRolesHint: Roles that must use 2FA when it is on
settings.checkinHint: In-progress tasks need a status update at this interval
settings.extensionHint: Who must approve a deadline extension
settings.lateDelayHint: Auto-record a delay when a task finishes after its approved due date
settings.probationReminderHint: Notify HR and superior before end
settings.reviewMonthHint: Month the yearly personal-details check launches
settings.reviewWindowHint: Days employees have to confirm their details
settings.empNoHint: How new employee numbers are made. Changing the format affects new employees only.
settings.renumberBody: Everyone gets a new number in join-date order, using the saved format. Old numbers are kept in the audit log.
settings.renumberSaveFirst: Save your format changes before renumbering.
settings.kpiModeHint: Calculate from Meridian's own task data, or import scores
access.stale: This role was changed by someone else. The latest permissions are now shown.
access.note: Access roles control what a person can do. They are separate from designations (career level).
updates.autoSoon: Automatic updates and the update log arrive with the installer and deploy script (M8). Until then, this page shows the installed version.
updates.logEmpty: No updates have run on this server yet.
coming.title: {page} is on its way
coming.body: This page arrives with the {module}. The menu shows it now so you can see where it will live.
error.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
